title: How to find us
subtitle: Whether by car, public transport, or on foot – here you'll find everything you need to reach us comfortably.

adress_card.title: Address
adress_card.office_details: Our office is on the left-hand side, number 19.
adress_card.image_alt: Street view of our office building

directions_card.title: Travel options
directions_card.subtitle: Choose the way that suits you best – we're conveniently located and well signposted.

by_public_transport.title: By public transport
by_public_transport.description: Take the tram or train to Nuremberg Central Station. From there it's just a few minutes to Virchowstraße 19.

on_foot.title: On foot / by bike
on_foot.description: From Nuremberg city center, follow Äußere Bayreuther Straße until you reach Virchowstraße 19.

by_car_A3.title: By car from the A3
by_car_A3.description: If you're arriving via the A3 motorway, take exit 85 "Nürnberg-Nord" and follow the signs toward Nuremberg. Stay on "Äußere Bayreuther Straße" for about 4.5 km. After this stretch, turn right onto Virchowstraße to reach your destination.

by_car_north_west.title: By car from the north or west
by_car_north_west.description: If you're approaching Nuremberg from the north or west, follow the Nordring (B4R) to the intersection with Äußere Bayreuther Straße. Turn right there onto Äußere Bayreuther Straße heading toward the city center. Shortly after, turn right again onto Virchowstraße.

by_car_south_east.title: By car from the south or east
by_car_south_east.description: If you're approaching Nuremberg from the south or east, follow the B4R toward the airport until you reach the intersection with "Äußere Bayreuther Straße". Turn left there onto "Äußere Bayreuther Straße" heading toward the city center ("Zentrum"). Shortly after, take the next right turn onto Virchowstraße.

map_card.title: Our location on the map
map_card.description: View our location on the map and plan your route easily.
map_card.disclaimer: We use Google Maps to display the map. Please consent to its use so the map can load.

window.title: Enable Google Maps
window.description: Loading the map transfers data to Google. For more information, please see our privacy policy.
window.subtitle: This choice only applies to your current visit.

on_your_way.title: Already on your way?
on_your_way.description: Just picture it – while you're making your way here, we're already getting ready for your project.
on_your_way.subtitle: Keep scrolling – your project is already on its way.
on_your_way.description2: Write to us – we're happy to help you plan your trip and answer any open questions in person.
